MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The magnets with mounting holes felt like a useful next choice because they extend my recent interest in magnetic mounting and could work with my small fasteners, provided the sizes fit.",
    "The magnetic hooks matched a clear recent interest, and the caliper had a plausible connection to measuring hardware, even though neither gave me enough reason to buy now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The half-inch washers are much larger than my recent M3–M5 screws, so their general connection to fasteners does not make them useful for the same work.",
    "The epoxies, wiring connectors, and infrared thermometer assume repair or measurement needs I have not shown; I would need a specific task before choosing them.",
    "The dorm decorating supplies share a hanging function with my magnetic hooks, but decorating walls does not match the mounting uses suggested by my recent purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying hardware seems to have been treated as interest in a broad range of workshop and repair supplies, regardless of what they would help me do.",
    "My recent magnetic-hook purchases seem to have been taken as a reason to offer another set, even though those purchases may already cover my needs."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Fastener dimensions matter to me: a washer needs to fit the hardware I am using, rather than merely belong alongside screws and nuts.",
    "A useful addition matters more than a repeat purchase right now; mounting holes offer a different option, while another pack of hooks duplicates what I just bought.",
    "I rarely choose items without an immediate use, so a tool being potentially useful is not enough to make me buy it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in magnetic mounting and small hardware but stretched it into unrelated project needs and repeat purchases."
}
